name: CounterFlow — Retail Store Operations
description: The operational layer around the till for boutiques and specialty retail: products and suppliers, stock movements, store tasks, staff and returns, with low-stock alerts and a stock-value estimate. Includes 6 forms and 1 app.

packMeta.name: CounterFlow — Retail Store Operations
packMeta.description: The operational side of a boutique, gift shop or pop-up around the POS: track products and stock levels, log every movement, run store tasks, manage the team and suppliers, and resolve returns — all linked together.
packMeta.author: FormLogic

apps.name: CounterFlow
apps.description: A retail operations hub for the counter: watch stock levels and value, log movements, run store tasks, keep the team and suppliers organised, and clear the returns queue from one dashboard.

blocks.title: Store operations overview
blocks.body: This report summarises the operational state of the store: what is on the shelf, how stock is moving, the task load on the team, and the returns picture. Use it for the weekly walk-through with staff, or as a snapshot before reorder day.
